summary: Iteration 20 — Backend refactor (routes/awards.py, routes/drafts.py, routes/matchups.py) non-regression + mobile-friendly auth contract. 15/15 pytest passed. test_crown_flow.py passed end-to-end (champion + consolation crowned, lottery boost applied to 2027 R1 pick #1 with boost=3). test_trade_flow.py passed end-to-end AFTER unsetting championship_won_at/consolation_won_at/conference_winner_at/division_winner_at on all teams between the two scripts (as the review-request called out). Mobile static review: api.js reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, useSocket.js imports BACKEND_URL from api.js, useGlobalSocketEvent hook exported, championship/consolation/conference/division crowned callbacks present in useLeagueSocket, DashboardScreen subscribes to all 4 crown events with native Alert toasts, AppNavigator wires Profile + Matchup under both HomeStack and LeagueStack. Backend non-regression aggregate /api/u/chriszarek still returns stats.{championships_won, conference_titles, division_titles, consolations_won, playoff_appearances} + teams[] with all 5 award timestamp fields. No ObjectId leaks observed in team-rewards response.

minor.issue: Requires `week` query param (returns 422 when omitted). Review-request called out the endpoint without mentioning the required param. Not a regression — confirmed pre-existing contract.

action_items: (LOW / docs-only) Document in routes/matchups.py or in README that test_trade_flow.py must be run with championship/consolation/conference/division timestamps CLEARED on all teams, otherwise the 'Team condition (no championship): blocked correctly' assertion fails due to stale state from test_crown_flow. Better: make test_trade_flow.py idempotent by running an _unset at its setup step.

(LOW) Open iter19 follow-up still valid: wrap Badge inside <span> on DraftLottery consolation-winners-card to silence hydration warning; verify ConsolationPrizeEditor Save toast actually renders (backend save is fine).

(INFO) server.py is still ~4406 lines post-refactor. The 3 new modules (awards 244 loc, drafts 23 loc, matchups 387 loc) account for only ~580 loc moved out. Consider extracting /trades, /players, /auth, /users next.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/__init__.py deps-injection pattern works but is silent-by-design: if setup() isn't called before include_router, all endpoints 500 on first request with KeyError('db'). Recommend adding a sentinel check at the top of each route handler (e.g. if not _deps: raise RuntimeError('awards router not initialised')) with a clear error so future mis-wiring surfaces at startup, not at request time.

routes/matchups.py auto-crown branch emits sio events for 4 bracket types but swallows sio.emit failures silently (inherited from the pre-refactor code, flagged in iter19 review). Add a logger.warning with league_id + winner_team_id on broadcast failure.

/api/auth/refresh returns a NEW access_token but echoes the SAME refresh_token back — acceptable, but consider refresh-token rotation (issue a new refresh_token each refresh and revoke the old one) for mobile, which keeps long-lived sessions on the device.

routes/awards.py PUT /awards endpoint: when the same field is set True twice, audit_log records duplicate 'championship_won_at set' entries without comparing to the existing value. Minor — but a no-op PUT still writes an audit row and re-runs all conditional trades.

ConsolationPrizeUpdate still accepts lottery_boost_spots=0 for type=draft_lottery_boost (apply_consolation_prize correctly no-ops with a warning, but a Pydantic validator would reject it at the edge). Re-flagged from iter19.
